page.body_html:
<!-- NOVAHAIR SALES FUNNEL — PRODUCTION STAGING (CRO ATF + 12 FAQ + BATCH 6 BANNER) -->
<div class="nova" dir="rtl" lang="he">
  <style>
/* Open Sans is loaded once by the dedicated NovaHair layout. */

/* ====================================================
   CSS VARIABLES & GLOBAL RESETS
==================================================== */
:root {
  --nh-bronze: #E07A28;
  --nh-bronze-dark: #C05621;
  --nh-bronze-soft: #FFF7F1;
  --nh-espresso: #1A1A1A;
  --nh-sand: #FAF7F2;
  --nh-cream: #FDFBF8;
  --nh-blush: #FBE3D1;
  --nh-gold: #D4AF37;
  --nh-text: #262626;
  --nh-text-soft: #555555;
  --nh-muted: #888888;
  --nh-border: #E8DFD5;
  --nh-white: #FFFFFF;
}

.nova {
  font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Arial Hebrew', Arial, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif !important;
  color: var(--nh-text) !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  direction: rtl !important;
  text-align: right !important;
}

.nova *, .nova *::before, .nova *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

.nova .wrap {
  max-width: 1120px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 0 16px !important;
}

.nova .sec {
  padding: 48px 0 !important;
}

.nova .sec-sand { background: var(--nh-sand) !important; }
.nova .sec-cream { background: var(--nh-cream) !important; }
.nova .sec-white { background: #FFFFFF !important; }

.nova h1, .nova h2, .nova h3, .nova h4 {
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  line-height: 1.25 !important;
}

.nova h1 { font-size: clamp(22px, 3.8vw, 32px) !important; }
.nova h2 { font-size: clamp(20px, 3.2vw, 28px) !important; text-align: center !important; }

.nova .sec-head {
  text-align: center !important;
  max-width: 720px !important;
  margin: 0 auto 36px !important;
}

.nova .sec-desc {
  font-size: 1rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
  margin-top: 8px !important;
}

.nova .eyebrow {
  display: inline-block !important;
  background: var(--nh-blush) !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze-dark) !important;
  font-size: .8rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  padding: 4px 12px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
}

/* ====================================================
   TOP ANNOUNCEMENT BAR
==================================================== */
.nova .topbar {
  background: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
  padding: 8px 12px !important;
  font-size: .84rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 20px !important;
  text-align: center !important;
}
.nova .topbar-item {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}
.nova .topbar-icon-img {
  width: 18px !important;
  height: 18px !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
}

/* ====================================================
   SECTION 1: COMPACT ATF CRO HERO
==================================================== */
.nova .hero {
  padding: 24px 0 36px !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
}

.nova .hero-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  gap: 24px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 990px) {
  .nova .hero-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.08fr !important;
    gap: 36px !important;
    align-items: start !important;
  }
}

/* Gallery Column (Right in RTL) */
.nova .hero-media {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
}

.nova .gal-main-wrap {
  width: 100% !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: var(--nh-sand) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(43,36,32,.06) !important;
}

.nova .gal-main {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  display: block !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
}

.nova .thumbs {
  display: flex !important;
  gap: 7px !important;
  overflow-x: auto !important;
  padding-bottom: 4px !important;
  scrollbar-width: thin !important;
}

.nova .thumb {
  width: 52px !important;
  height: 52px !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  border: 2px solid transparent !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
  opacity: .68 !important;
  transition: all .2s !important;
  background: var(--nh-sand) !important;
}

.nova .thumb:hover { opacity: .95 !important; }
.nova .thumb.sel { border-color: var(--nh-bronze) !important; opacity: 1 !important; }

/* Purchase Column (Left in RTL) */
.nova .hero-info {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
}

.nova .nh-official-badge-slot {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  font-size: .78rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze-dark) !important;
  background: var(--nh-blush) !important;
  padding: 3px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
  width: fit-content !important;
}

.nova .hero-rating {
  font-size: .88rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}
.nova .hero-rating span { color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important; font-weight: 400 !important; }

.nova .hero-head h1 {
  font-size: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 26px) !important;
  margin: 4px 0 6px !important;
  line-height: 1.25 !important;
}

.nova .hero-subhead {
  font-size: .92rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  line-height: 1.45 !important;
}

/* 3 Compact Value Pills */
.nova .product-value-pills {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  margin-top: 2px !important;
}

.nova .product-value-pill {
  padding: 4px 10px !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: var(--nh-sand) !important;
  color: var(--nh-text) !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 4px !important;
}

/* Decision Steps Box */
.nova .step-box {
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 12px 14px !important;
}

.nova .step-label {
  font-size: .92rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}

.nova .step-sub {
  font-size: .78rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}

/* Shade Swatches Grid */
.nova .shade-grid {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  align-items: center !important;
}

.nova .shade-option {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  padding: 5px 10px 5px 6px !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all .15s ease !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  font-size: .84rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.nova .shade-option:hover { border-color: var(--nh-bronze) !important; }

.nova .shade-option.sel {
  border-color: var(--nh-bronze) !important;
  background: var(--nh-bronze-soft) !important;
}

.nova .shade-swatch {
  width: 24px !important;
  height: 24px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.15) !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}

.nova .shade-option.sel .shade-swatch {
  outline: 2px solid var(--nh-bronze) !important;
  outline-offset: 1px !important;
}

/* Mix Shades Dedicated Button */
.nova .mix-shades-btn {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  padding: 6px 12px !important;
  border: 1px dashed var(--nh-bronze) !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze-dark) !important;
  font-size: .82rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  transition: all .15s ease !important;
}

.nova .mix-shades-btn:hover, .nova .mix-shades-btn.is-active {
  background: var(--nh-bronze-soft) !important;
  border-style: solid !important;
  border-color: var(--nh-bronze) !important;
}

/* Mix Allocation Drawer */
.nova .mm-drawer {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 10px !important;
  padding-top: 10px !important;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
}

.nova .mm-drawer.open { display: block !important; }

.nova .mm-header {
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  font-size: .84rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
}

.nova .mm-tally.complete { color: #16a34a !important; }
.nova .mm-tally.incomplete { color: #dc2626 !important; }

.nova .mm-row {
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  padding: 4px 0 !important;
}

.nova .mm-shade-info {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  font-size: .84rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.nova .mm-ctrls {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
}

.nova .mm-btn {
  width: 28px !important;
  height: 28px !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  font-size: 1rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
}

.nova .mm-btn:hover { background: var(--nh-sand) !important; }
.nova .mm-qty { font-size: .9rem !important; font-weight: 800 !important; min-width: 18px !important; text-align: center !important; }

/* Compact Horizontal Bundle Cards (78px - 88px) */
.nova .bundle-cards-container {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card {
  position: relative !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 8px 12px !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  transition: all .18s ease !important;
  min-height: 78px !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card:hover { border-color: var(--nh-bronze) !important; }

.nova .bundle-card.sel {
  border-color: var(--nh-bronze) !important;
  border-width: 2px !important;
  background: #FDF8F3 !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(224, 122, 40, 0.12) !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__right {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__thumb {
  width: 58px !important;
  max-height: 62px !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__details {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 2px !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__badge-inline {
  display: inline-block !important;
  background: var(--nh-bronze) !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
  font-size: .68rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  padding: 1px 6px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  width: fit-content !important;
  margin-bottom: 2px !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__title {
  font-size: .98rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__per-bottle {
  font-size: .78rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__pricing {
  text-align: left !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: flex-end !important;
  gap: 1px !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__price {
  font-size: 1.25rem !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__old {
  font-size: .76rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-muted) !important;
  text-decoration: line-through !important;
}

.nova .bundle-card__savings {
  font-size: .74rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze-dark) !important;
}

/* Primary Dynamic CTA Button */
.nova .btn-primary-cta {
  width: 100% !important;
  min-height: 52px !important;
  background: var(--nh-bronze) !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  font-size: 1.12rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(224, 122, 40, 0.25) !important;
  transition: all .2s ease !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.nova .btn-primary-cta:hover {
  background: var(--nh-bronze-dark) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

.nova .btn-primary-cta.is-disabled {
  background: #9ca3af !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  cursor: not-allowed !important;
}

/* CTA Summary & Compact Trust Row */
.nova .cta-summary-line {
  width: fit-content !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  margin: 10px auto 0 !important;
  padding: 8px 13px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  font-size: .86rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  background: #F7F1E8 !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
}
.nova .cta-summary-line::before {
  content: "הבחירה שלך" !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze-dark) !important;
  font-size: .72rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  padding-left: 8px !important;
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(140,109,43,.25) !important;
}
.nova .purchase-trust-row {
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 6px 0 !important;
  margin-top: 9px !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
  font-size: .79rem !important;
  font-weight: 650 !important;
}
.nova .purchase-trust-row span {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}
.nova .purchase-trust-row span + span::before {
  content: "·" !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze) !important;
  margin: 0 9px !important;
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .nova .cta-summary-line { flex-direction: column !important; gap: 3px !important; }
  .nova .cta-summary-line::before { border-left: 0 !important; padding-left: 0 !important; }
  .nova .purchase-trust-row { font-size: .73rem !important; }
  .nova .purchase-trust-row span + span::before { margin: 0 6px !important; }
}

/* ====================================================
   SECTION 2: PROOF BAR (HUGE HIGH-IMPACT ICONS)
==================================================== */
.nova .proof-bar {
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  padding: 24px 0 !important;
}

.nova .proof-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .nova .proof-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 20px !important;
  }
}

.nova .proof-card {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}

.nova .proof-icon-wrap {
  width: 92px !important;
  height: 92px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
}

.nova .proof-icon-img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  object-fit: contain !important;
}

.nova .proof-num {
  font-size: 1.15rem !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze) !important;
}

.nova .proof-lbl {
  font-size: .84rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

/* ====================================================
   SECTION 3: BEFORE / AFTER
==================================================== */
.nova .ba-card {
  max-width: 860px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(43,36,32,.04) !important;
}

.nova .ba-img-wrap {
  width: 100% !important;
  line-height: 0 !important;
}

.nova .ba-img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  display: block !important;
}

.nova .ba-labels {
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: space-around !important;
  padding: 10px 0 !important;
  background: var(--nh-sand) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: .9rem !important;
}

/* ====================================================
   SECTION 4: MECHANISM
==================================================== */
.nova .mech-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  gap: 24px !important;
  align-items: center !important;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .nova .mech-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr !important;
    gap: 32px !important;
  }
}

.nova .nh-microsphere-desktop { display: block !important; }
.nova .nh-microsphere-mobile { display: none !important; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .nova .nh-microsphere-desktop { display: none !important; }
  .nova .nh-microsphere-mobile { display: block !important; }
}

.nova .nh-microsphere-desktop img, .nova .nh-microsphere-mobile img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  display: block !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
}

.nova .mech-points {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
}

.nova .mech-point {
  background: var(--nh-sand) !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 16px !important;
  border-right: 4px solid var(--nh-bronze) !important;
}

.nova .mech-point-title {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  margin-bottom: 4px !important;
}

.nova .mech-point-desc {
  font-size: .88rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* ====================================================
   SECTION 5: FORMULA & EXPERT BLOCK
==================================================== */
.nova .bot-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .nova .bot-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 20px !important;
  }
}

.nova .bot-card {
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  padding: 20px !important;
  text-align: center !important;
}

.nova .bot-img-slot {
  font-size: 2rem !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}

.nova .bot-card-title {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  font-size: 1.05rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  margin-bottom: 6px !important;
}

.nova .bot-card-benefit {
  font-size: .86rem !important;
  color: var(--nh-text-soft) !important;
}

.nova .bot-support {
  text-align: center !important;
  font-size: .92rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--nh-bronze-dark) !important;
  margin-top: 20px !important;
}

/* Professional Expert Block Redesign */
.nova .expert-block {
  margin-top: 48px !important;
  padding-top: 40px !important;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--nh-border) !important;
}

.nova .expert-head {
  text-align: center !important;
  margin-bottom: 28px !important;
}

.nova .expert-head h3 {
  font-size: 1.35rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: var(--nh-espresso) !important;
  margin-top: 6px !important;
}

.nova .expert-section__grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  gap: 28px !important;
  align-items: stretch !important;
  max-width: 920px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
}

@media (max-width: 749px) {
  .nova .expert-section__grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    gap: 20px !important;
  }
}

.nova .expert-card {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  border: 1px solid #E8D7C7 !important;
  border-radius: 18px !important;

  window.selectColor = function(colorKey, colorLabel) {
    state.color = colorKey;
    state.colorName = colorLabel;
    
    // If we were in mix mode, selecting a normal shade switches back to single shade mode cleanly
    if (state.isMix) {
      state.isMix = false;
      var drawer = document.getElementById('mmDrawer');
      var mixBtn = document.getElementById('mixShadesBtn');
      if (drawer) drawer.classList.remove('open');
      if (mixBtn) mixBtn.classList.remove('is-active');
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.nova .shade-option').forEach(function(el) {
      if (el.getAttribute('data-color') === colorKey) {
        el.classList.add('sel');
      } else {
        el.classList.remove('sel');
      }
    });

    updateUI();
  };

  // 3. MIX & MATCH TOGGLE
  window.toggleMixMode = function() {
    state.isMix = !state.isMix;
    var drawer = document.getElementById('mmDrawer');
    var mixBtn = document.getElementById('mixShadesBtn');
    
    if (state.isMix) {
      if (drawer) drawer.classList.add('open');
      if (mixBtn) mixBtn.classList.add('is-active');
      // Initialize mix allocation cleanly to current bundle size
      resetMixAlloc();
    } else {
      if (drawer) drawer.classList.remove('open');
      if (mixBtn) mixBtn.classList.remove('is-active');
    }

    updateUI();
  };

  function resetMixAlloc() {
    var targetQty = state.prices[state.pack].qty;
    // Reset all to 0
    Object.keys(state.mmAlloc).forEach(function(k) { state.mmAlloc[k] = 0; });
    // Assign total to currently selected shade
    state.mmAlloc[state.color] = targetQty;
    renderMmInputs();
  }

  // 4. MIX QUANTITY CONTROLS (+ / -)
  window.updateMmQty = function(colorKey, delta) {
    var targetQty = state.prices[state.pack].qty;
    var currentTotal = Object.values(state.mmAlloc).reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
    var currentVal = state.mmAlloc[colorKey] || 0;
    var newVal = currentVal + delta;

    if (newVal < 0) return;
    if (delta > 0 && currentTotal >= targetQty) return; // limit to bundle size

    state.mmAlloc[colorKey] = newVal;
    renderMmInputs();
    updateUI();
  };

  function renderMmInputs() {
    Object.keys(state.mmAlloc).forEach(function(k) {
      var span = document.getElementById('mmQty_' + k);
      if (span) span.innerText = state.mmAlloc[k];
    });
  }

  // 5. BUNDLE SELECTION
  window.selectPack = function(packKey) {
    state.pack = packKey;
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.nova .bundle-card').forEach(function(el) {
      if (el.getAttribute('data-offer') === packKey) {
        el.classList.add('sel');
      } else {
        el.classList.remove('sel');
      }
    });

    if (state.isMix) {
      resetMixAlloc();
    }

    updateUI();
  };

    var buySec = document.getElementById('buy');
